notes:
### New

- Update checks now run in the native background every 24 hours, even if the app stays open without interaction. Check history survives restarts, and overdue checks resume after sleep or connectivity returns. New releases retain an update entry and appear when the main window is visible and idle; installation and restart remain explicit actions.
- AI and cloud transcription models now use searchable inline lists with individual enable switches, an enabled-only filter, and custom model IDs. Newly connected services start with no models enabled.
- Streaming dictation can progressively insert recognized text into the target input, then replace that draft with the AI-processed result. If the input target changes, WhisperPal stops rewriting it and preserves recovery text.

### Improved

- Provider configuration groups connection testing with the API key, puts the API address on its own row, and moves advanced connection details out of the main workflow. Key visibility only applies to a newly entered value; saved credentials remain masked.
- Platform defaults and application defaults are explicit. Disabling a model preserves its existing bindings as unavailable rather than silently switching models or accounts.
- Refined the live meeting transcript layout, reading controls, and AI interactions.
- Improved Slack Huddle title selection to prefer the active call surface over navigation-window titles.
- Updated cloud AI and transcription protocol handling, including Doubao streaming recognition.
- Added a guided first-run setup for microphone, recording, and transcription configuration.

Automatic checks respect the existing opt-out and Skip This Version settings. Remind Me Later suppresses another prompt for the same version for 24 hours, including across app restarts. Manual checks remain available, and update installation or restart never interrupts an active recording or dictation.

notes_i18n.zh-CN:
### 新增

- 原生后台每 24 小时自动检查更新，应用一直开着、不操作也会检查。检查记录跨重启保留，睡眠或离线恢复后补查到期更新。发现新版保留更新入口，等主窗口可见且空闲时再提示；下载、安装与重启仍由用户主动操作。
- AI 与云端转录模型改为可搜索的内联列表，支持逐项开关、仅查看已启用模型及添加自定义模型 ID。新连接平台的模型默认全部关闭。
- 流式听写支持将识别结果逐步输入目标输入框，再用 AI 整理结果替换草稿。输入目标变化时停止改写，并保留文本供恢复。

### 改进

- 平台配置将连接测试与 API 密钥放在一起，API 地址独立一行，高级连接信息折叠收纳。密钥显示仅作用于本次新输入，已保存密钥保持脱敏。
- 平台默认模型与应用默认绑定分别显式设置。关闭模型后保留原绑定并标记不可用，不自动切换其他模型或账号。
- 优化实时会议文稿布局、阅读控制与 AI 交互。
- 改善 Slack 抱团标题识别，优先使用实际通话界面信息，避免采用消息导航窗口标题。
- 改善云端 AI 与转录协议兼容性，包括豆包流式识别。
- 新增首次使用引导，协助配置麦克风、会议录制与转录方式。

自动检查遵守原有关闭设置及“跳过此版本”选择。“稍后提醒”后同一版本 24 小时内不再重复弹窗，重启应用也会保留。手动检查仍可使用；安装与重启更新不会打断进行中的会议录制或听写。
